text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Is that girl named Agnes Tachyon?
She was incredible, wasn't she!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, you can really feel her talent...!
That girl is definitely going places!"

The brilliance Agnes Tachyon displayed
commanded the attention of the entire venue—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
choice_data_list: That was a great run, Tachyon!
That was a great run, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Trainer-kun!
You still have those pure, innocent guinea pig eyes as always!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Were you able to buy the tea without any trouble?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "—Anyway, more importantly, there's something I needed to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "We made it through the debut race safely. Rather than taking a breather, there's an important report to give. You understand, don't you?"
Speaking of an important report right at this timing, after finishing a debut race—
choice_data_list: (Could she be talking about the next race!?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My research has hit a critical point,
so I must head back right away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And so, I'll be taking my leave.
With that said, she casually walked away...

Setting aside her thoughts on the debut race,
she walked off without saying a word
about her future prospects, but――

—That being said, it was a fact that she had
become an Umamusume in the public eye!
